title: Lutos, no irrigation, hottest and driest brief, mid-September
rationale: Good loam in the sand belt, so the soil lever is gone and only the weather is left. Dăbuleni's day-0 tMax is 23.6 °C, the warmest captured, with a +3.8 °C last-month temperature anomaly, 10.8 mm of forecast rain over 16 days, day-0 water balance -4.1 mm and soil moisture 0.114 m³/m³. Sowing rapeseed dryland into that is the case's target error: rapita_toamna is drought_tolerance scazuta with its critical period at September-October establishment, so wheat (medie) and rye (ridicata) both outrank it. grau_toamna is asserted into the top because lutos is in its suitable_classes and its southern windows run to 10-20.
